arguments.summary: Registered BIS policy source was unavailable, and the supplied SEC materials are filing indexes/financial facts rather than inspected issuer risk disclosures. Accordingly, no current export-control action, legal status, or issuer-specific China/supply-chain/digital-ad exposure can be verified for this 21/63-session assessment. QQQ provides only a dated, now-stale look-through for NVDA, MU and META.

claims.text: QQQ’s supplied holdings snapshot is dated 2026-09-12 and marked stale; it reports NVDA at 8.45%, MU at 4.85%, and META at 3.07%.

Any verified semiconductor export-control shock affecting NVDA or MU could transmit into QQQ through those reported holdings, but the supplied snapshot neither establishes current weights nor quantifies sensitivity or an effect on fund returns.

Over 21/63 sessions, a newly enacted or enforced trade/export restriction could affect affected issuers through sales eligibility, customer demand, component availability, or compliance costs; direction and magnitude cannot be determined without the operative policy text and issuer exposure disclosures.

gaps.description: The registered BIS policy source returned unavailable, so no dated primary policy text or proposal/enactment/enforcement status could be verified.

No inspected issuer primary disclosure in the available evidence quantifies China/other cross-border revenue, export-control restrictions, supplier/geographic concentration, or Meta cross-border digital-ad exposure.
QQQ holdings are stale and do not provide ANET exposure or a policy-sensitivity decomposition.

assumptions: A potential policy event is treated only as a contingent scenario, not as current policy or a forecast.
Reported QQQ holdings are a dated fund-composition reference, not a personalized portfolio exposure.
arguments.counter_thesis: Absent a verified new or enforced restriction, geopolitical/trade policy may not be the proximate driver of 21/63-session results; issuer fundamentals, sector demand and market factors may dominate.

review_conditions.description: Review if an accessible primary BIS/other competent-government document establishes a dated export-control or trade measure, including legal status and affected technology/categories.
Review upon issuer filing disclosure that quantifies cross-border revenue, restricted-product exposure, supply-chain concentration, or Meta international advertising exposure.

question_effects.reason: Company-specialist response was not available within this task; current supplied materials do not quantify the requested exposures.

shared_exposures.mechanism: QQQ’s dated holdings snapshot includes these three companies; a company-specific geopolitical/trade-policy development could therefore be reflected indirectly in the fund.
shared_exposures.qualification: Snapshot is 2026-09-12 and marked stale; reported holdings are not current weights, do not establish causality, and do not quantify fund sensitivity.
